purpose: Canonical registry for the multidimensional belief atlas behind the unified index.
navigation: Every lexicon entry resolves to a canonical belief record; religious records can additionally resolve to their foundation, comparative library and historical layers through index.html.
integrity: The religious cube is a projection of a richer record, not the record itself. Coordinates are analytical models, not measurements of truth or worth.
epistemic_rule: Political and religious classification is descriptive/analytical; theological truth claims remain distinct from empirical evidence.
routePolicy: Belief-space data remain canonical backend records. Public interpretation belongs in mature Religion/Philosophy readers; deep record inspection resolves through Explore by canonical path.
